from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the listed company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code of the company")
    reporting_period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="End date of the reporting period in YYYY-MM-DD format")
    equity_attributable_to_shareholders: float | None = Field(description="Owner's equity amount attributable to shareholders of the listed company")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., Yuan or CNY")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_records: list[FinancialRecord]
